title: Periapt of Wound Closure
summary: Automatically stabilise when Downed and maximise healing received.

fields.Wound Closure: If Downed, automatically stabilise at the start of your turn.
fields.Potent Healing: Healing you receive restores its maximum possible HP. Healing you give another creature is unchanged.
fields.Acquisition: Lady Esther northeast of the Trielta Crags waypoint.
fields.Base value: 125 gp standard base value, 410 gp in Honour Mode. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
